description: Agent Grants: submit disbursement records with the payment schedule in the award: the records with the grant, the currency, the day they are current to and each disbursement with its id, the scheduled tranche it disburses, the amount, the day disbursed and each condition the record shows met before it; the schedule with the grant, the currency, its stated total and each tranche with its id, amount, scheduled day and each condition the award states before it. The signed report gives the records and the schedule, each disbursement paired with its tranche, every disbursement outside the schedule or recorded twice against one tranche named, each tranche’s amount and day on both sides and the conditions stated before it against those recorded as met, and counts them, and names a discrepant record set: a disbursement outside the schedule or recorded twice against one tranche, another currency or amount than the schedule sets, a tranche disbursed before its scheduled day and one disbursed without each condition stated before it recorded as met; then a tranche disbursed late, a tranche past its day with no disbursement, a stated total unlike the tranches and another grant name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A disbursement with no day or an amount on one side only, conditions stated with none recorded as met, or a schedule with no tranches leaves the records unverified. Disbursements pair with the tranche they cite, or one citing none with an unpaid tranche of the same amount, amounts compare to the cent in one currency, days read as days and conditions read by their words with plurals folded. This check keeps no state and moves nothing: the conditional payments rail tools wever_conditional-create, wever_conditional-fund, wever_conditional-status, wever_conditional-cancel and wever_conditional-attest create, fund, cancel and report on payments held against conditions between parties, keeping state and moving money, and the payout rail tools wever_payout-create and wever_payout-execute create and disburse USDC payouts, while the disbursement check reads tranche records against an award schedule; wever_invoice-check and wever_invoice-payment-match read invoices for work done and match them to payments, and a grant disbursement is not an invoice and is matched to no payment for work; and wever_edu-aid-check reads a student’s financial aid disbursements against the aid award letter, and a student’s aid stays with it, while the disbursement check reads a grant award’s tranches. Verdict grant_disbursement_discrepant, grant_disbursement_partial, grant_disbursement_unverified or grant_disbursement_consistent. POST /api/grant-disbursement-check. Reads the grant records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never applies for a grant, awards one, disburses or moves any money, or judges the merit of an applicant, a project, or a funder’s decision, only whether the records agree with each other and with the terms they were written under, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Grants reads a grant’s records for consistency between documents: a grant application, a proposed budget, an award letter or grant agreement, milestone records, disbursement records, spending records, a progress or final report and a closeout record, each against the call or guidelines, the terms in the call or award, the application as submitted, the schedules in the award, the approved budget, the records it summarizes or the award terms it should agree with. Beside it, the conditional payments rail tools such as wever_conditional-create create, fund, cancel and report on payments held against conditions between parties, keeping state and moving money, and the Job Records tools such as wever_job-cost-brief read the records of paid work orders, while this family keeps no state, moves nothing, commissions no work and reads the grant records in the call against each other and against the terms they were written under. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-grants-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-grants/.

conditions.description: Each condition the award states before it.
